'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Howdy, soldier! I got a new toy in, been wondering where to try it out. And here you are, just in time for this. Take this RPD, go to some outdoorsy areas, and let it rip.}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate any 40 targets with an [[Degtyarev RPDN 7.62x39 machine gun|RPDN]] with [[Axion Kobra EKP-1S-03 reflex sight (Dovetail)|EKP-1S-03 sight]] on [[Shoreline]], [[Lighthouse]], or [[Reserve]]

==Rewards==
* +65,000 [[EXP]]
* +4 [[Light Machine Guns|Light Machine Guns skill]] levels
* +4 [[Heavy Machine Guns|Heavy Machine Guns skill]] levels
* [[Prapor]] Rep <font color="green">'''+1.5'''</font>
* 400,000 Roubles
** 420,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 460,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[Armband (RFARMY)]]
* 2× [[AK 7.62x39 Molot Arms 75-round drum magazine]]
* 6× [[7.62x39mm BP gzh ammo pack (20 pcs)]]
* Unlocks purchase of [[AK 7.62x39 Molot Arms 75-round drum magazine]] at [[Prapor]] LL3
{{quote|So how do you like it? Good, yeah? It's a real beauty in combat!}}

It's possible to use a compact reflex sight mounted on a [[NcSTAR MPR45 Backup mount|canted rail]] when using the [[RPD DS Arms Railed Handguard]] instead of the [[Axion Kobra EKP-1S-03 reflex sight (Dovetail)|EKP-1S-03 reflex sight]] to obtain the kills. The sight just needs to be installed to count towards the quest.
